description: Jeu LOT-18 sans donnée personnelle pour qualité, refus et sécurité Text-to-SQL.

cases.question: Quel est le score moyen des régions en 2025-02 ?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(score) AS average_score FROM analytics_risk_scores WHERE geographic_level = 'region' AND reference_period = '2025-02' LIMIT 1

cases.question: Classe les dix départements au score le plus élevé en 2025-02.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT geographic_code, score FROM analytics_risk_scores WHERE geographic_level = 'department' AND reference_period = '2025-02' ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: Quelles sont les cinq régions au score le plus faible en 2025 ?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT geographic_code, score FROM analytics_risk_scores WHERE geographic_level = 'region' AND reference_period = '2025' ORDER BY score ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Compare le score des régions 32 et 11 en 2025-02.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT geographic_code, score FROM analytics_risk_scores WHERE geographic_level = 'region' AND geographic_code IN ('11', '32') AND reference_period = '2025-02' ORDER BY geographic_code LIMIT 2

cases.question: Comment le score du département 59 évolue-t-il entre 2024-02 et 2025-02 ?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT reference_period, score FROM analytics_risk_scores WHERE geographic_level = 'department' AND geographic_code = '59' AND reference_period IN ('2024-02', '2025-02') ORDER BY reference_period LIMIT 2

cases.question: Compare le taux de chômage des régions en 2022.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT region_name, value_numeric FROM analytics_macro_regions WHERE reference_year = 2022 AND indicator_code = 'taux_chomage_1564' ORDER BY region_name LIMIT 200

cases.question: Quelle est la part moyenne des familles monoparentales par région en 2022 ?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(value_numeric) AS average_value FROM analytics_macro_regions WHERE reference_year = 2022 AND indicator_code = 'part_familles_monoparentales' LIMIT 1

cases.question: Quels facteurs expliquent le score de la région 32 en 2025-02 ?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT indicator_code, contribution FROM analytics_score_factors WHERE geographic_level = 'region' AND geographic_code = '32' AND reference_period = '2025-02' ORDER BY contribution DESC LIMIT 200

cases.question: Compare les modèles 1.1.0 et 1.2.0 pour les départements en 2025-02.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT geographic_code, score_a, score_b, score_change FROM analytics_model_comparisons WHERE geographic_level = 'department' AND reference_period = '2025-02' AND version_a = '1.1.0' AND version_b = '1.2.0' ORDER BY geographic_code LIMIT 200
